## Validation

- [ ] Normal CTest passes.
- [ ] Elevated live tests pass when capture behavior changed.
- [ ] New decoders or hardware paths have synthetic regression coverage.
- [ ] Hardware claims include reproducible evidence or are explicitly marked unverified.
- [ ] JSON/CSV fields, exit codes, capabilities, and structured Agent errors are backward compatible, or the change is documented as breaking.
- [ ] CLI catalog, generated help, and `docs/COMMAND_REFERENCE.md` are synchronized when commands or options change.
- [ ] Schemas and contract tests were updated when machine-readable output changed.
- [ ] Durable docs were updated (README, USAGE, DEVELOPMENT, ARCHITECTURE, PUBLIC_CONTRACT, AGENT, COMPATIBILITY, DIAGNOSTICS, TODO, RELEASE).
- [ ] No raw ETLs, dumps, secrets, credentials, or machine-specific sensitive paths are included.
